exposure: Type of previous myomectomy (hysteroscopic, laparoscopic, laparotomic)
finding: Previous laparoscopic and abdominal myomectomies were associated with uterine rupture in pregnancy, and hysteroscopic myomectomy was associated with uterine rupture at earlier gestational ages.
gest_age: Uterine rupture occurred, on average, at 36 weeks of pregnancy
birth_weight: Gestational age and birth weight seemed not to be affected in the subsequent pregnancy
